name: Malicious rApp deployment
description: An attacker deploys and exploits a malicious rApp
remediation: Only allow images from approved registries using ClusterPolicy
long_description: Malicious rApps could impact non-RT RIC functions such as AI/ML model training, A1 policy management, Enrichment information management, Network Configuration Optimization in the purpose of performance degradation, DoS, enrichment data sniffing, etc
